new.n: Ojibwe sugar camp on the 1856 GLO plat, Couderay River
new.pl: West township line near the sec. 6/7 corner, T38N R8W, Sawyer County (1856 GLO plat)
new.st: The 1856 government survey plat of T38N R8W marks a "Sugar Camp" on the west township line near the corner of secs. 6 and 7, with a trail running northeast from it through sec. 6. This was an Ojibwe maple-sugar camp of about 1855. A trail or road also ran along the east side of sec. 1. Plat only; the line notes have not been checked.
new.t: Look on LiDAR for the trail trace and a camp flat in the maple stand. This is a native camp site: look only, take nothing.
new.warn: Native camp site: look only, take nothing.
src: GLO township plat T38N R8W, Wisconsin (1856), UW Digital Collections
pinev: Plat label at the sec. 6/7 corner on the west township line, placed from the BLM PLSS corner (about 300 m).
